description: Waveshaper running the input through a trigonometric function, chosen from sine, cosine and tangent in regular, hyperbolic or inverse form

params.text: Picks sine, cosine or tangent, shown by the lamp beside it
Picks the plain function, its hyperbolic form or its inverse arc form
Scales the input before it reaches the function, -1 to +1, inverting it below zero; lower settings use less of the function's curve
Sets the voltage range expected at the input, 5V or 10V; the output is scaled back out to the same range
AC passes the output through a DC blocking filter; DC leaves the offset in, which cosine and the arc functions produce a lot of

inputs.text: Shifts the function selection, one step per 2.5V, added to the knob setting
Shifts the mode selection, one step per 2.5V, added to the knob setting

outputs.text: The shaped signal, clipped to the selected voltage range
